description: Review rubric for parent-communication templates (push / email / in-app message copy targeted at parents).

criteria.label: Tone appropriateness
criteria.description: Tone is respectful, informative, not alarmist. Treats parents as informed partners, not customers to be sold to.

criteria.label: Factual accuracy about student progress
criteria.description: If the message refers to student data (streaks / mastery / mock scores), the wording matches what the app actually tracks. No 'your child is failing' when the data doesn't say that.

criteria.label: No dark pattern / no anxiety-induce
criteria.description: Does not manufacture urgency, fear, or shame to drive engagement. No 'your child is falling behind' framing without supportive next step.

criteria.label: Clarity of action / CTA
criteria.description: If there's a CTA, it's specific and unambiguous. If informational only, that's clear too.

criteria.label: Indian-parent cultural fit
criteria.description: Language + framing fits Indian-parent expectations. Hindi-medium / regional-medium fallback (when un-deferred) is grammatically correct.

approval_rule: factual_accuracy + no_dark_pattern MUST be 5/5. Senior PM sign-off required (cannot be junior-approved).
